evidence.observation: T held at 749.7-750.0 °C for 750 °C setpoint after a brief overshoot to 760 °C at t=2520 that settled within about 240 s
Pheat steady at about 43-44% during growth, matching the temperature reading
P steady at about 758.4-759.5 Torr through the whole run, no pressure trend
Not installed (null); growth stage requires it, so an air leak or oxidizing atmosphere can't be ruled out, since pressure near atmospheric would not show a leak

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading during growth, or another atmosphere check such as a leak-up or leak test, to confirm the tube held an inert atmosphere; then post-run characterization of the sample.
